title: Azuki Bean Zenzai
description: A Japanese-inspired dessert made with azuki beans, perfect for a sweet treat.

ingredients.name: exotic spices
ingredients.notes: such as cardamom or star anise

instructions: Combine the azuki beans and water in a saucepan and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes, or until the azuki beans are tender.
Mash the cooked azuki beans with a fork.
Combine the mashed azuki beans, zenzai, and sugar in a bowl.
Stir in the matcha powder, if using.
Add a pinch of exotic spices to taste.
Serve warm or chilled, garnished with additional zenzai and exotic spices, if desired.
